ALL NOTES.

John Martin — INDEPENDENT CREATIVE
John Martin / Behind the Work

MADE FROM EXPERIENCE. DRIVEN BY CREATIVITY. DEFINED BY NOTHING.

I believe that creativity has no fixed destination.

It’s a constant process of learning, experimenting, observing, and creating. I don’t believe in being confined to one discipline and defined by one style.

I base my designs on vision, experience, and inspiration. Every project is an opportunity to explore something new while staying true to my own creative form.

Always evolving. Always learning.

John Martin — INDEPENDENT CREATIVE
John Martin / The Archive

A COLLECTION OF DESIGNS MADE, MOMENTS SHARED, AND IDEAS THAT HAVE BEEN BROUGHT TO LIFE.

Everything started as an idea that later turned into sketches, late-night experiments, rough concepts, countless hours, and ideas that simply needed somewhere to go.

This is where I keep pieces of that journey — past work, creative experiments, production snapshots, and everything in between.

A reminder that everything has a starting point.

John Martin — INDEPENDENT CREATIVE
John Martin / Culture

HOW CULTURE INSPIRES MY CREATIVE EXPRESSION.

Every creative has a story, and mine is deeply rooted in the environment I grew up in.

Coming from the Philippines, I’ve been shaped by the people, places, experiences, and cultures that surrounded me.

From the streets and music to fashion, art, and everyday life, these influences have all contributed to how I see the world.

I don’t create out of nowhere or in isolation. Everything I’ve experienced becomes part of my perspective, slowly finding its way into the things I make.

This is where my creativity comes from.

John Martin — INDEPENDENT CREATIVE
John Martin / Clothing brand

HOMEGROWN

Staying true to your roots.

Homegrown is a clothing brand built around individuality, self-expression, and the idea that style has no limits.

No matter where you are or how far you’ve come, there will always be something that reminds you where you came from. A place, a memory, a person, or an experience that makes you look back and say, “Yes, I’m from here.”

That became the foundation of Homegrown.

It started with one question:

How can I represent where I’m from through visual expression?

Through clothing and design, I wanted to turn that idea into something people could wear — something that represents their roots, their identity, and their story.

From idea to product
